# Decision tree

[Previous: Influence diagram](./influence_diagram.md) | [Workflow](./README.md) | [Next: Compact tree](./compact_tree.md)

Explore the model as sequences of decisions and uncertain outcomes. Start with the visible branches and expand them progressively to inspect the paths of interest. See [Decision trees](../domain/decision_tree.md) for interpreting branches, policies, and expected values.

## Choose the tree view

### Open the tree view selector

Select **Decision Tree** in the sidebar to choose a tree representation of the model.

![Decision Tree sidebar entry](<./figures/decision_tree/button - Decision Tree.png>)

### Choose a tree representation

Choose **Tree**, **Compact**, or **Solution** to view the model in the corresponding tree representation.

![Decision Tree view selector popup](<./figures/decision_tree/popup - Decision Tree.png>)

### Explore the decision tree

Use the decision tree to examine the model as sequences of decisions and uncertain outcomes.

![Decision tree page](<./figures/decision_tree/page - Decision tree.png>)

## Navigate and expand branches

### Navigate the decision tree

Use the toolbar to zoom, fit the tree to the viewport, expand visible branches, and read value metrics.

![Decision tree toolbar](<./figures/decision_tree/menu - Decision tree toolbar.png>)

### Expand one branch

Select a plus node to reveal the next part of that branch of the decision tree. A plus placeholder indicates more detail is available; it is not a terminal outcome or an unexplained final result.

![Decision tree branch expansion node](<./figures/decision_tree/button - Expand node.png>)

### Expand visible tree branches

Select **Expand All** to expand all currently visible expansion nodes; repeat as needed to explore deeper levels.

![Expand All button in the decision tree](<./figures/decision_tree/button - Expand All.png>)

### Inspect the expanded tree

After expanding branches, fit the tree to the viewport to examine the newly revealed paths.

![Decision tree after expanding visible branches](<./figures/decision_tree/page - Decision tree expanded.png>)

## Review calculated results

Read option labels, uncertainty probabilities, and values along the branches, then compare the tree's expected-value metrics with the influence diagram. Use the same model inputs and selections when comparing views; resolve validation warnings and unintended conditional selections before treating a difference as a modelling conclusion.

![Expected-value metrics in the decision tree](<./figures/decision_tree/card - Expected value metrics.png>)
